acceptanceCriteria: affected.Build observes context cancellation and deadline at bounded intervals during the walk and plugin phases.
An expired deadline yields a typed refusal or unknown, never a partial plan presented as complete.
A maintained test cancels a build over a large fixture and shows prompt return with the typed outcome, for both standalone affected and the review fallback.
The governing affected-plan spec carries the numbered requirement and traceability.
body:
Filed 2026-10-06 by the orchestrator session.

Found by the V1-0865 lane on branch claude/v1-0865-review-affected (head 8c1a7d87, base origin/main 3dc863bd), by code reading. affected.Build in internal/liveverify/affected does not observe the caller's context deadline or cancellation. Standalone `corvint affected` cannot be bounded, and since V1-0865 `review --base` runs the same path as its fallback when the guidance inventory is incomplete, so review inherits the unbounded walk. Expected: a deadline or cancellation stops the build and yields a typed unknown or refusal. Actual: the build runs to completion. Related: V1-0279 (MCP flows impact cancel), V1-0865.
title: affected.Build ignores the context deadline, so standalone affected and the review fallback cannot be bounded or cancelled
